ja.subtitle: 友だちと渋谷で迷わず待ち合わせ
ja.promotionalText: 渋谷駅から半径1.5km限定。お互いが承認した相手とだけ、距離と方角を共有して迷わず会えます。3D渋谷・近くのお店・ARで相手の方向がひと目で分かります。登録不要・無料。
ja.keywords: 待ち合わせ,渋谷,位置共有,合流,友達,距離,方角,コンパス,矢印,3D地図,AR,集合,迷子,駅,ハチ公,現在地,道案内,PLATEAU
ja.description:
渋谷で友だちと待ち合わせるとき、「今どこ？」「どの出口？」のやりとりはもう要りません。

渋谷マチマチは、お互いが承認した相手とだけ距離と方角を共有して、迷わず会うための1対1の待ち合わせアプリです。

■ 使い方
1. ニックネームを入れて「待ち合わせを作る」を押す（アカウント登録は不要）
2. 1回だけ使える招待リンクを、会う相手にLINEや共有シートで送る
3. 相手がリンクを開いて参加し、あなたも承認すると共有スタート
4. 相手までの距離（m）と方角の矢印が表示されます
5. 20m以内・同じ階まで来たら「会えた！」

■ 主な機能
・距離と方角の矢印：端末のコンパスで、相手のいる方向を指します
・今いる階の共有：B5〜10Fを選ぶと「相手は2つ上の階にいます」と表示
・3D渋谷：国土交通省PLATEAUの3D都市モデルで、2人の位置を立体的に表示
・近くのお店：相手のそばのお店を近い順に表示（目印に）
・ARで探す：カメラの映像に、相手のいる方向と距離を重ねて表示
・デモで試す：1台で、模擬の相手が近づいてくる流れを体験できます

■ プライバシーを最優先に
・お互いが承認するまで、位置は一切送りません
・相手に届くのは距離・方角・階の差だけ。座標そのものは届きません
・渋谷駅から半径1.5kmの外では共有を止めます
・「共有をやめる」でその場で削除、待ち合わせは3時間で自動的に消えます
・アカウントなし、広告なし、トラッキングなし

■ ご注意
・位置の共有が使えるのは、渋谷駅から半径1.5km以内です
・知らない人と出会うためのアプリではありません。すでに知っている友だち・知人との待ち合わせにお使いください

■ データの出典
建物: 国土交通省 3D都市モデルPLATEAU（渋谷区, CC BY 4.0）／地図: 地理院タイル／店舗: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)

ソースコードはGitHubで公開しています（MIT License）。
サポート: https://shibuya-machimachi.kaeru3160.workers.dev/support
プライバシーポリシー: https://shibuya-machimachi.kaeru3160.workers.dev/privacy

reviewNotes:
Thank you for reviewing Shibuya Machimachi (渋谷マチマチ).

1. How to use - testing on ONE device (Demo mode)
- No login is needed. Launch the app and tap "デモで試す（1台で体験）" (Try the demo on one device) on the first screen. The demo runs entirely on the device: nothing is sent and your real location is not used.
- A demo invite screen appears; after about 3 seconds a simulated partner "すず" joins. Tap "この人と位置を共有する" (Share location with this person).
- The meetup screen then shows the distance (m) and a direction arrow while the simulated partner walks toward you (faster than real life), plus the floor difference, nearby shops ("近くのお店"), the 3D Shibuya map ("3D渋谷") and "ARで探す" (AR view with the camera; the camera image never leaves the device). (Note: the web version at the support URL also offers a "高画質で見る" high-detail 3D view; this build of the iOS app does not show that button.)
- When the partner is within 20 m on the same floor, tap "会えた！" (We met!). Tap "終了" or "共有をやめる" (Stop sharing) to finish.
Real use with two devices: on device A enter a nickname and tap "待ち合わせを作る" (Create a meetup), then send the one-time invite link to device B (share sheet / LINE / copy). Device B opens the link (in the app or in any browser), enters a nickname and taps "承認して参加" (Approve & join). Device A taps "この人と位置を共有する". Only after both approvals are distance and direction exchanged. Location permission is requested only when you create or join a real meetup.

2. Purpose and target users
A 1-on-1 meetup tool for people who ALREADY know each other (friends, family, acquaintances) to find each other around the crowded Shibuya Station without repeated "Where are you?" calls. There is no feature to discover, browse or meet strangers: a meetup is created by one person, can be joined only through the single-use invite link that person sends, is limited to 2 people, and is deleted after 3 hours.

3. External services
- Our own server on Cloudflare Workers / Durable Objects (https://shibuya-machimachi.kaeru3160.workers.dev) for meetups and realtime distance.
- MLIT PLATEAU 3D city model (buildings shown in the 3D Shibuya map; the building geometry is bundled in the app, not fetched at runtime).
- GSI tiles (Geospatial Information Authority of Japan) for map images.
- OpenStreetMap data (shop names), bundled in the app.
- TypeSafe AI Jev for the "We met?" check: it receives numbers only (distance, same-floor flag, elapsed time) - never coordinates or nicknames. Without it the app falls back to a distance-only check.
No analytics, advertising or tracking SDKs.

4. Regional differences
Location sharing works only within 1.5 km of Shibuya Station, Tokyo. Outside that area the app pauses sharing and shows "渋谷エリアの外なので共有を止めています" (You are outside Shibuya, so sharing is paused). Since the review team is outside Shibuya, please use Demo mode (item 1), which simulates a position in front of Shibuya Station. The user interface is in Japanese.

5. Accounts, payments, user-generated content
No account or login. No in-app purchases or payments; the app is free. The only user-entered content is a nickname (up to 20 characters) shown only to the one invited person. No chat, posts or public profiles. Either person can end sharing at any time with "共有をやめる" (Stop sharing), which immediately deletes both positions; the meetup cannot be rejoined.

6. Third-party data and licenses
- Buildings: MLIT PLATEAU 3D city model (Shibuya-ku), CC BY 4.0.
- Map tiles: GSI tiles (Geospatial Information Authority of Japan), used with attribution under the GSI terms of use.
- Shop data: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
Attribution is shown in the app under the 3D map and in the map's attribution control. The app's source code is open source (MIT): https://github.com/Ryoseiimai/shibuya-machimachi

Privacy policy: https://shibuya-machimachi.kaeru3160.workers.dev/privacy
